reason: Net-additive work, not a refactor that failed to lower anything: orchestrator/tests/conftest.py gains the autouse _forbid_agent_cli_spawn guard, which fails any orchestrator test that starts an agent-CLI process (claude/codex/gemini/pi) at subprocess.Popen.__init__ and again at teardown, so a stale invoke_agent patch target (the task-882 incident) fails loudly instead of silently calling the real CLI. The +2 cognitive is the spawns_agent_cli marker opt-out and the teardown verdict; the guard logic itself lives in tests/_agent_cli_guard.py, outside the cluster.
